title: Elevated 5xx errors on inventory-sync from downstream API rate limiting (HTTP 429)
description: logistics-vendor-api began returning HTTP 429 (rate limit exceeded) to inventory-sync. Retries without effective backoff amplified the request volume, the circuit breaker flapped, and unwrapped 429s surfaced to callers as cascading 5xx errors. Stock-sync jobs are falling behind and storefront inventory is going stale.
